description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit treatment records, dental procedures included as treatment entries, with the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records they answer to: the reading moment; each visit or diagnosis entry with its id, reference, the animal, its kind (visit or diagnosis) and the moment recorded; each discharge entry with its id, reference, the animal, the visit it closes and the moment discharged; each treatment entry with its id, reference, the animal, the visit or diagnosis behind it, its kind (treatment or dental), the treatment or dental procedure, the medication administered, the moment treated, the moment the record schedules a follow-up treatment and the treatment it follows up; each prescription record entry with its id, reference, the animal, the medication and the moment prescribed. The signed report gives the treatments and the records behind them, each treatment against the visit or diagnosis entry behind it, each treatment against the discharge entry closing its visit, each follow-up treatment the record schedules against a treatment recorded for it, and each medication administered against the prescription record, and counts them, and names divergent treatment records: a treatment with no visit or diagnosis entry behind it, a treatment entry recorded after the discharge entry, a follow-up treatment the record schedules with none recorded, and medication administered in a treatment entry that the prescription record does not show; then a discharge entry naming a visit the records do not hold and a treatment following up a treatment the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No treatment entries, no visit or diagnosis entries beside treatments, or no prescription record beside medication administered leaves those points unverified. Visits, discharges and treatments match by letters and digits, medications by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, a treatment naming no visit rests on a visit or diagnosis entry for its animal on or before it, and a follow-up due after the reading moment waits. This reads whether every treatment and dental procedure in the practice’s treatment record rests on a visit, falls inside it and is dosed under a prescription. Verdict vet_treatment_record_divergent, vet_treatment_record_partial, vet_treatment_record_unverified or vet_treatment_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-treatment-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.
